action: The restated FY2023 Revenues ($67.95B to $35.35B) reconciles to the removal of GE Vernova Inc. (CIK 0001996810) (8-K items 1.01,1.02,2.01,2.03,5.03,9.01, filed 2024-04-02): its own filings report $33.24B for the period (residual: over-explained by $633.0M (1.9% of the effect)). Scope follow-up requests to that residual and to the discontinued-operations reclassification before sign-off.
root_cause: GE Vernova Inc. (CIK 0001996810), the separate registrant behind the disposal GE reported in its 8-K filed 2024-04-02, reports Revenues of $33.24B for FY2023; add-back: restated $35.35B + GE Vernova Inc. $33.24B = $68.59B vs original $67.95B (gap $633.0M, tolerance 5% = $3.40B); explains 102% of the -$32.61B restatement; residual over-explained by $633.0M (1.9% of the effect); reconciled

evidence.sql:
SELECT cik, first(h._source.display_names[i]) AS name, count(*) AS hits,
       min(h._source.file_date) AS first_date, max(h._source.file_date) AS last_date,
       concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(h._source.form))) AS forms,
       concat_ws(',', sort_array(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(h._source.items))))) AS items,
       max(hits.total.value) AS total
FROM tiresias_sec.fts_59fd5affcf9f1314_raw
LATERAL VIEW explode(hits.hits) AS h
LATERAL VIEW posexplode(h._source.ciks) AS i, cik
GROUP BY cik
ORDER BY hits DESC, cik DESC
LIMIT 20
evidence.filter: documents containing "general electric" in 10-12B/10-12G filed 2022-10-10..2024-04-02; cik not the source; hits >= 0.25 x the top filer's; first 3
